title: Rosenberg Indoor Comfort Gives Back This Holiday Season
desc: Rosenberg Indoor Comfort is sponsoring a program to raise awareness and collect donations for organizations in the San Antonio community.

blocks.text: Rosenberg Plumbing & Air has been offering premier heating and cooling services to the San Antonio, TX, area for over a decade. We have developed a strong sense of connection with our community, and that is why we are sponsoring programs to help those who are struggling.
Raising Awareness and Donations for Those Who Need a Little Extra Help

For the month of October and through the end of the year, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air is sponsoring a program to raise awareness and collect donations for organizations that serve special populations in the San Antonio community. The first organization we are sponsoring is the Battered Women and Children’s Shelter. This organization has a mission to break the cycle of violence and to strengthen families who are in crisis. They provide emergency shelter, transitional housing, and parenting education to help families heal and grow. They also provide specialized intervention for children, youth, and the elderly, as well as programs for those who perpetrate the abuse. Currently, we are asking our clients and team members to make donations or collect clothing and toys to deliver to the shelter for those in need.

The second organization is the San Antonio Cancer Council. The SA Cancer Council provides support to patients in need. All donations made to the organization go to fund cancer research and provide financial resources and patient assistance to help ease the strain. They help both those who are currently undergoing treatment for cancer and survivors.

One way the SA Cancer Council does this is with Cure Cancer cards. These cards give cancer survivors discounts at local stores during certain events. The San Antonio Cancer Council has been serving the community for over 37 years and has raised more than $5.6 million to help patients and research.

As the temperatures drop, it is time to give you a gentle reminder to have your heating system serviced and any maintenance issues fixed before peak season begins. The worst time to find out that your heating system needs repair is in the middle of a cold snap. Fortunately, many circumstances like these can be prevented through seasonal inspections and maintenance.

One of the main advantages of keeping your heating system in good repair is to prevent maintenance issues from turning into significant problems that are costly to repair. You do not want to get caught when you need your system the most.
If you are experiencing any of these problems, we can help.

blocks.text: Another way you can tell that it is time for HVAC maintenance is that you might see a rise in your energy costs. Keeping up with regular maintenance can save you money over time by keeping your unit working as efficiently as possible.

If you have been wondering if it is time to consider a new one, our team of experts can look at your old system and help you decide if a new one would be more cost-effective. Newer systems are often more efficient and can help save on energy costs over time.
